messages:
maria: Heads up — spotted a screenshot in a public GitHub issue that looks like a customer's webhook secret (starts with sk_live_...). Screenshot: https://github.com/example/repo/issues/123#issuecomment-4567890 :eyes:

samir: can you paste the screenshot? link above good. We should rotate immediately.

maria: pasted, redacted link. The secret in clear: sk_live_9aBcDEFgHiJkL... appears to be for customer acme-corp webhook ingestion.

sec-oncall: ACK. I'm going to revoke the key now and create a replacement. @infra-bot run `revoke_api_key --key sk_live_9aBcDEFgHiJkL`

infra-bot: Command received: revoke_api_key sk_live_9aBcDEFgHiJkL — success. Key status: revoked at 2140007923.

samir: thanks. I'll create a new key in KMS and update the webhook config in our ingestion service. Generating key... vault path: projects/redwood/kms/acme/webhook

kevin: ping support — ask them to tell customer to update their webhook secret and rotate any local copies.

jonah: on it. Drafting message to Acme: short note + recommended actions. Will send once infra confirms new key and rollout.

samir: new key created: sk_live_r3N7xYz... stored in KMS. Pushing config change to staging, will canary to prod.

infra-bot: Deployment started: rollout webhook-config acme-corp new-secret ref:deploy-829 — started 2140008050

maria: audit logs — can we check whether that leaked key was used after the screenshot was posted? Querying logs now: `SELECT * FROM api_requests WHERE api_key='sk_live_9aBcDEFgHiJkL' AND timestamp >= '2026-01-09T09:10:00Z'`

samir: ran logs search — 3 failed auth attempts from 52.14.23.5 between 09:15-09:18 UTC, then one successful request at 09:19 from ip 34.201.5.190. Payload matches ingestion endpoint /webhook/events.

sec-oncall: That suggests possible customer event ingestion after leak. We need to confirm customer IDs and whether any PII passed.

kevin: I pulled the payload sample — looks like event metadata only, no user PII. Customer team confirm?

jonah: Acme confirms they send hashed IDs, no PII. Still we'll treat as incident. Inform legal and Cx. I'll raise a ticket.

sec-oncall: Notifying legal and privacy: @legal-team please review (incident id SR-2026-01). Prepare disclosure if needed.

infra-bot: Audit search results archived at https://internal/logs/incidents/SR-2026-01

maria: post-incident tasks: 1) confirm full list of keys in PR/issue history 2) add automated SCA detection on screenshot uploads in support portal 3) check S3 logs for accidental uploads.

samir: adding RBAC checklist: restrict who can view raw webhook secrets in console — feature ticket created: PLAT-4532

jonah: I sent initial notice to customer with rotation instructions and offer for timeline. They appreciate quick action.

sec-oncall: Next steps: confirm no exfil of sensitive customer records, rotate any matching keys in other environments, add monitoring rule for reused revoked keys. ETA for full RCA 48h.

maria: thanks team. I'll compile timeline and write postmortem once we have logs. :white_check_mark:

jonah: closing loop with Acme after RCA. :handshake:

kevin: for follow-up, schedule an audit of support screenshot uploads and consider watermarking or redaction UI.

sec-oncall: incident moved to postmortem queue SR-2026-01. last_action_ts 2140008732
